quality_notes: ONS territorial, residence or production, and consumption or footprint accounting bases remain explicitly separate.
ONS current and provisional atmospheric-emissions editions remain distinct and revision status is retained.
DfT SAF 2025 fifth-provisional and RTFO 2025 fifth-provisional status are not converted into final observations; November 2026 final publication remains future.
Vehicle licensing and EV charging infrastructure remain stock/activity/infrastructure evidence rather than direct measured greenhouse-gas emissions.
Ofgem BUS applications, vouchers, grants and product eligibility remain scheme-administration evidence rather than measured emissions reductions.
DESNZ conversion factors and UK ETS country-specific factors remain calculation/reporting tools rather than direct measurements.
Local-authority aggregates remain subnational estimates and are not assigned to individual parcels.
Defra carbon-footprint correction history and consumption accounting remain distinct from territorial and residence measures.
Publication date, reference period, unit, denominator, stock/flow and revision status are explicitly guarded.
No unsupported conversion, future-release observation or individual parcel emissions value was inferred or produced.
